reuse.why: Calls the existing shouldWriteMonthBudget rule, averageToBudgetAmount sign helper, getSheetValue, setBudget and the mutator/undoable wiring, but re-pastes the category-selection SQL instead of extracting a shared query.

duplication.why: The category SELECT (with group_hidden and has_saved_template) and the batch/filter loop are copied verbatim from set3MonthAvg, making a fifth copy of that query.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to its siblings and is registered in budget/app.ts like the other month-wide methods.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler registration and one test are added.

maintainability.why: The rule and sign are shared, but another copy of the category query means a future change to which columns/joins feed the rule must be repeated in five places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses shouldWriteMonthBudget and averageToBudgetAmount from month-action.ts; no existing shared category query was bypassed (the tree has none).

disguised_duplication.where: The copied SQL/loop in setLastMonthSpending (actions.ts) is a verbatim copy of set3MonthAvg's, not disguised.
